# Pinterest

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 10 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Inspiration marketing chrome: white page, Pinterest red primary pill, warm-gray secondary and search, 48px header buttons, signup wall left unsubmitted.

Captured 2026-11-19, signed out (public marketing and signup wall only; account was not created). Themes: light.

Pinterest's public signed-out marketing chrome and the signup wall, measured on 19 November 2026. No account was created and no login was submitted. The page theme was Gestalt `calico` / `lightMode`.

## Typography

6 styles from `core.typography`. `fontFamily` is the first family of each stack; the full stacks, and properties DESIGN.md has no field for (text case, decoration), are in tokens.json. Families: Pin Sans.

### Fonts (from README.md)

Pin Sans is Pinterest's face, named in `--base-font-family-default-latin` and computed on the body. It is proprietary and is not in this package. The token stack falls back to `-apple-system`, `BlinkMacSystemFont`, `Segoe UI`, `Roboto`, then `sans-serif`. Code uses the `--base-font-family-code` stack, starting at SF Mono.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

Hover and pressed reds are declared Gestalt tokens. A live pointer was not placed on a button. The primary button element computed `color: #000000` while `--comp-button-color-text-primary-default` resolved to `#ffffff`. The white label is the token. Focus ring colour is declared and was not forced. The 390px pass still laid out the desktop header past the viewport, so it is not a phone layout. Policy type (84px / #111111) is a different site and is not in the homepage tokens. Placeholder `#757575` is a computed style, not `--sema-color-text-subtle`.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Use the Pinterest red for the primary action.** Log in and Join computed `#e60023`, radius 16px, height 48px.
- **Use the warm gray for the secondary action and the search shell.** Sign up and the search shell computed `#e5e5e0`.
- **Keep the page white and the footer black.** Page background computed `#ffffff`. Footer computed `#000000`.
- **Set display type in Pin Sans at 900 with -0.5px tracking.** The homepage hero computed 48px / 900 / -0.5px.
- **Leave the signup wall unsubmitted.** Email, password, birthday, and Google continue were on the page and were not entered.
